channel.title: Global Fastener News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Fastener News (globalfastenernews.com)

item.title: Howmet Reports Strong Fastener Revenue Growth
item.description: Fastening Systems revenue growth driven by a strong commercial aerospace market, partially offset by lower volumes in the commercial transportation market.

item.title: Nylon Fasteners Names Business/Operations Head
item.description: Connor Hurding joined UK-based Nylon Fasteners in 2021 as Operations Coordinator.

item.title: Randy Ladutko Retires from Supply Technologies
item.description: “I seriously doubt that many of us who are in this industry planned on it when we were young unless you were born into it... I grew up caddying for the president of a fastener division and needed a job out of college.”

item.title: Century Fasteners Names Operations GM
item.description: New operations manager brings 34 years of fastener industry experience and has been an integral part of Century Fasteners since 1996.

item.title: AZ Wire & Cable Opens in SoCal
item.description: AZ Wire & Cable opened in Santa Fe Springs, CA, to serve the West Coast with local distribution and sales.

item.title: Semblex Hires Key Accounts Manager
item.description: New manager joins Semblex with global experience from Jinhap’s Overseas Sales Team, where he supported international customers and partnered with Semblex on key initiatives.

item.title: Fastenal CSO: Supply Chain Boosted Fastener Sales
item.description: “We have sourcing, quality and engineering teams stationed in manufacturing regions around the globe, providing a high-level of supply chain visibility and control.”

item.title: LSG Promotes Swanson to VP
item.description: New executive, who joined LindFast Solutions Group in 2017 as Controller, earned a BBA in accounting and finance from the University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire.

item.title: Tariffs Slow Hillman Group Sales
item.description: Cincinnati-based distributor reported decelerated sales growth and a gross margin decline as higher tariff costs made an impact in 2025.

item.title: BBI’s Haggerty Elected to Pac-West Board
item.description: Denver Branch Manager Carrie Haggerty “has been an instrumental part of B-RIGHT-ON’s success for more than twenty years,” BBI stated.
